title.narrative: Retrofitting of public buildings through green technologies and processes (RE-FIT)

description.narrative: As sustainable energy (SE) measures in buildings are still not fully implemented in Lebanon, with a high energy consumption and substantial economic and environmental costs, it is proposed to upgrade public and non-operational renewable energy installations and equipment (e.g. photovoltaic (PV) panels and PV lead batteries ) in public buildings through the set-up of new financially viable repair and recycling processes.

title.narrative: New disposal system for PV panels and batteries setup. Pilot site establishedng of agricultural service providers

description.narrative: This output plans to make a pilot experience of recycling and reuse PV panels and batteries. The Action will try to establish a collection and disposal scheme for PV batteries and ewaste through a pilot scheme of waste collection, using the ewaste collected from the 26 selected public buildings. During the implementation phase, the Action will assess to what extent, depending on the characteristics of each PV installation, it will be preferable to use actual PV panels or refrigerated ones, which type of battery is more cost efficient (lithium, lead), if the reuse of recycled batteries is efficient, if it is possible to improve the used technology, if it is possible to have an online control system for the installations, etc. The Action will implement a pilot storage facility in accordance with International standards, actually inexistent in Lebanon, to export the batteries to European countries key nutrition indicators at the national level in collaboration with DEVCO and partners.
